messages:
Ana: Heads up — invoice-preview jumped ~+12% for a handful of tenants after yesterday's sampling tweak. Looks correlated with sampler lease heartbeat spikes. Anyone else see weird fingerprint churn? :thinking:

Devon: yep. We noticed the route-fingerprint TTL resetting during lease renewals. That seems to cause duplicate session attribution across shards.

Marta: Can you paste the sample logs? wondering if it's a serialization/order change when we normalize headers.

Ana: pasted excerpt:
```
2026-03-20T23:02:12Z lease=tx-gt-23 renew heartbeat=0.12s fingerprint=sha1(tenant:route:v2)
2026-03-20T23:02:12Z sampler=alloc id=slot-8 fingerprint=sha1(tenant:route:v3) // switched form
```

Kyler: ah — we shipped the header-normalization patch that changed ordering for `x-route-attrs` earlier. That will flip fingerprint outputs. We should've preserved old-order compatibility.

Ana: that makes sense. still puzzled why invoice preview spike is concentrated on reserved-capacity routes? expected broader churn.

Devon: preview pipeline uses compact-agg window (30s) + route-stickiness to de-duplicate. If fingerprint flips inside the compact window we count two sessions instead of one -> invoice bump for that tenant. Reserved flows tend to have longer-lived sessions so they hit the window more.

Marta: Two remediation paths:
1) revert header-normalize (breaks other fixes), or
2) make fingerprinting resilient. Proposal: deterministic canonicalization (sort attrs, normalize spacing) + salted hash that is stable across reorder. Also add a post-agg coalesce step to merge candidate fingerprints that differ only by attribute ordering.

Jordan: canonicalization is preferable long-term but will change historical cardinality. We need a staged migration/rollout: canary in eu region, metric target: per-tenant invoice delta < 2% before full roll.

Prod-ops: UX ask — can console expose a preview toggle "canonicalization: on/off" so finance can eyeball invoice delta before committing? Also want a telemetry flag to sample both old and new fingerprints.

SRE-bot: FYI deploy queued: header-normalize v1.3 -> canary at 23:15 UTC :rocket:

Kyler: alternative minimal-change approach: emit both `fingerprint_v1` and `fingerprint_v2` in meter events (v2 canonicalized). Aggregator prefers v2 but falls back to v1 if v2 missing. Preview UI can show a diff, and we can run comparison queries to estimate invoice impact without changing aggregation immediately.

Marta: that seems sane — extra event fields but makes rollout safe. I'll open a schema PR (metering-schema) and add a consumer feature-flag for aggregation consumers.

Ana: can we also add a lightweight console card for "fingerprint flip rate" per-route (percent flips / 1m) to surface hotspots? that will help catch regressions during rollout.

Jordan: agree — I'll prioritize a small telemetry tile and a one-click diff in invoice-preview for canary tenants. Marking as P0 for this commit window due to billing impact.

Ana: followups: Marta opens schema PR, Kyler drafts fallback logic + dual-fingerprint emitter, Jordan adds console tile + preview toggle, Devon will run sampling queries to baseline. reconvene after canary results. :thumbsup:
